# Movian Jellyfin (NEO)

Modern Jellyfin client plugin for Movian on PlayStation 3 — Jellyfin 10.9-10.11+, hardened HTTP/session layer, strict PS3 device profile. Public fork of LouisMarotta/m7-jellyfin.
